blocks.content: The row renderers. TimelineRow dispatches on item kind: user bubbles (with 📎 image counts and hover-copy), assistant bubbles (markdown via renderMarkdown with hover-copy), ThoughtBlock (live-expanding thinking), ToolCard (icon, status tone, args summary, live output tail, unified diff for writes/edits), and system/error notices. TimelineRow is memoized and assistant bodies cap rendering at 50k characters with a truncation notice, so a per-delta streaming update re-parses only the changed row (2026-10 hardening).
Auto-expands while a run_command streams; diffs render with patch-add/patch-del coloring.
Clipboard write with a ✓ confirmation flicker.
